rule_applied.warning: CPT 38101 is a separate-procedure splenectomy code. When splenectomy is performed only to manage an iatrogenic splenic injury during another abdominal operation, it is generally not separately reportable. If the splenectomy was performed for trauma, pre-existing splenic disease, malignancy, abscess, hypersplenism, or a distinct indication, separate reporting may be supportable with documentation.
source_basis: CMS NCCI Policy Manual hemic/lymphatic guidance
